correctness.rationale: The determinant-one rung/horizontal-slope substitution identifies the dual volume with powers of the continuous kernel 2-|s-t|. Explicit second-derivative and boundary equations derive the generating function without missing normalizations. A Gram representation establishes positivity; exact cosine eigenvalue roots and squared spectral projections reconstruct the moment sequence. Strict Cauchy–Schwarz yields log-convexity and a spectral-gap estimate proves the sharp asymptotic. The included independent exact rational Ehrhart checker, using integrality of graph-incidence constraints, matches volumes in dimensions 3–13; numerical roots only illustrate precise implicit constants.

value.rationale: Anchored polar volume of finite Lipschitz-free graph spaces is a motivated Banach-space geometric invariant. Open two-row ladders form a natural first-width grid-strip family whose exact finite-volume sequence was not supplied by the compared literature. A complete generating function, full positive spectral expansion, sharp exponential constant and strict all-dimensional volume-ratio law have meaningful structural value beyond routine isolated counting. A potential future use is the transfer-kernel comparison with wider grids, but the result stands without an unproved downstream theorem.
